title: Ghostly Boat Procession
description: A surreal scene viewed through an ornate oval frame decorated with skulls, flowers, insects, and candy. Multiple silhouetted figures stand in paper boats floating on dark water under a glowing sunset sky, with a large purple vortex, a cracked moon emitting purple smoke, and scattered birds.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene framed in an ornate pink oval border covered with skulls, flowers, insects and candy. Multiple black silhouetted figures sailing in paper boats on dark water, some holding swords or lanterns, purple flowers blooming from boats. Dramatic cracked glowing moon with purple smoke trails, swirling purple vortex in the sky, flock of birds, sunset clouds. Dreamlike and eerie atmosphere.
